Hi Alicia — great to hear. I attached a draft MAP and a short SOW template for your procurement team (Clearline_MAP_v2.pdf, Draft_SOW_Clearline.docx). Key commercial bullets below to help your packet:

- Payment terms: Net30 (standard). We accept POs; for new enterprise customers we can accommodate Net60 on a case-by-case basis with finance approval.
- Invoicing cadence: Monthly invoicing in arrears by default. We can invoice monthly or quarterly by arrangement.
- Billing start date: Billing starts on the first full calendar month after go-live OR, if you prefer, on contract signature with the first invoice pro-rated to go-live date.
- Ramp & discounts: We offer tiered discounts tied to committed monthly spend (e.g., 5% at $X/month, 10% at $Y/month). Discounts require a 6- or 12-month committed ramp schedule that we include in the SOW.

Proposed timeline (high level):
- 9/12: Finalize MAP & SOW edits
- 9/15: Legal review complete
- 9/19: PO issued / contract signed
- 10/01: Target go-live (example)

Hi Priyom,

Procurement has reviewed the SOW and MAP. We can move quickly but require the following commercial terms to be reflected in the contract and SOW:

1) Payment terms: Net60 standard for the organization.
2) PO requirement: We will issue a PO prior to signature; invoicing must reference the PO number.
3) Invoicing cadence: Monthly in arrears (invoices submitted on the 5th of each month for prior month usage).
4) Billing start date: First invoice to be issued the first billing cycle after go-live. If go-live occurs mid-month, invoice will be pro-rated for that partial month and billed on the first full billing run following go-live.
5) Deposits: Procurement prefers not to make any upfront cash deposits. If Redwood requires partial prepayment, we need a justification tied to capacity reservation.
6) Discounts and commitments: Discounts must be explicitly tied to committed monthly consumption tiers, documented in the SOW, and tracked. Any performance credits or refunds will be per the SLA appendix.

We need the editable MAP and an updated SOW reflecting the PO field and the Net60 language by COB Monday 9/15 to stay on your requested timeline.

Regards,
Purchasing Team
Clearline Health

Hi — thanks for the clarity and for the fast review. We can accommodate most of your items. Proposed updates for the SOW/MAP:

- Payment terms: Redwood is willing to accept Net60 for Clearline Health for the first 12 months if a PO is issued and the SOW includes a 6-month minimum committed ramp schedule.
- PO: Accepted. All invoices will include the PO number and a reference to the SOW line item.
- Invoicing cadence: Monthly in arrears; invoices will be submitted on the 5th for prior month usage.
- Billing start: Billing will start on first full billing cycle after go-live; partial-month pro-ration will be applied to the first invoice.
- Deposits: We will waive a cash deposit if the PO + 6-month ramp commitment is in place. Without that PO/commit, Redwood requires either (a) a 25% prepayment to reserve capacity or (b) Net45.
- Discounts: We can offer a first-year new-customer discount of 8% tied to a 12-month committed spend tier OR an introductory 5% for a 6-month ramp. Discounts will be codified in the SOW and applied monthly against invoice.

Next steps: I will update the SOW and MAP to reflect the Net60 language and the PO field and send back by COB Monday. Please confirm the PO timeline so we can include the PO number in the contract. If Procurement insists on no commitment at all, we will need the 25% prepayment or shift to Net45.
